ns2:course.label: Manga: The Art of Image and Word
ns2:course.description: Introduction to manga (Japanese comics), its production, its history in both a Japanese and global context, and the fundamentals of manga as an art form and part of the larger cultural traditions of Japan; emphasis on critical analysis of a variety of manga in translation and related scholarly articles; discussion of the evolution of manga and the ways it interacts with culture and society.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Cultural Studies - Non-West course.
